headline.zh: 用群聊AI智能体规划团队活动
headline.en: Plan Team Events with Group Chat AI

scenario.zh: 公司团建需要订场地、协调时间和安排拼车，用Instinct在群聊中完成协作规划
scenario.en: Coordinate a company outing venue, schedules, and carpools using Instinct in your group chat

instruction.zh: 决定智能体在群聊中协助的主要任务类型
instruction.en: Decide what the agent will help your group accomplish

output.zh: 智能体已加入群聊，开始收集成员的日期偏好和预算范围
output.en: Agent joined chat and began collecting member date preferences and budget ranges

output.zh: 智能体已加入群聊，开始询问成员出发地点和可载人数
output.en: Agent joined chat and started asking members for departure locations and passenger capacity

instruction.zh: 群里有3位朋友未注册Instinct，选择智能体的交互方式
instruction.en: Three friends lack Instinct accounts; choose how the agent interacts

label.zh: 直接在群聊中收集信息

output.zh: 智能体向所有成员提问并汇总回复，无账户成员正常参与讨论
output.en: Agent asked questions and summarized replies; non-account members participated normally

output.zh: 智能体通过私聊收集已注册成员意见，其他成员信息需手动转达
output.en: Agent collected input from registered members privately; others required manual relay

title.zh: 审核智能体的操作请求

instruction.zh: 智能体请求分享你的日历和支付信息给群组，选择授权范围
instruction.en: Agent requests to share your calendar and payment info with group; choose authorization

output.zh: 个人智能体已隔离隐私数据，仅向群组智能体提供可用日期
output.en: Personal agent isolated private data and shared only available dates with group agent

output.zh: 智能体等待你在群聊中手动输入时间偏好，未访问个人数据
output.en: Agent awaited manual input in chat without accessing personal data

instruction.zh: 对比智能体整理的两个方案，选择更适合团队的选项
instruction.en: Compare two plans organized by the agent and select the better fit for your team

label.zh: 方案A：周六下午场地+5辆拼车
label.en: Plan A: Saturday afternoon venue + 5 carpools

output.zh: 智能体已整理：22人确认参加，预计费用分摊后人均较低
output.en: Agent summarized: 22 confirmed attendees with lower per-person cost after split

label.zh: 方案B：周日早晨场地+公共交通
label.en: Plan B: Sunday morning venue + public transit

output.zh: 智能体已整理：18人确认参加，交通时间更短但需自行购票
output.en: Agent summarized: 18 confirmed with shorter transit time but self-service ticketing

takeaway.zh: Instinct的群聊智能体支持无账户成员协作，个人智能体会在分享数据前请求授权，隔离隐私信息
takeaway.en: Instinct's group agent works with non-account members while personal agents request authorization before sharing and isolate private data
